overall: The AG found the committee had not announced the release of two sets of executive session minutes as § 22(g)(1) requires, but it had since made the announcement and complied with the prior order, so the matter was closed without further order.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to comply with a May 2011 order to release and announce release of its Sept. and Oct. 2010 executive session minutes.
allegations.key_passage: However, the Committee did not announce at an open meeting that the minutes had been publicly released, as required by G.L. c. 30A, § 22(g)(1),
